name: slice-b-tiles
note: Slice B, the TILES lane (docs/art/slice-b/tiles.md): ground samples in the approved style, each a 4 x 4 patch at 256 px per tile (one atlas slot per tile). Grass, dirt and stone are single-type patches drawn to repeat; the edge subject is a straight grass-to-dirt boundary. HARD BUDGET 6 images on gpt-image-2; four subjects here, two in reserve for a retry. Guides: guides/patch4.png (sixteen pale cells), guides/edge4.png (two green columns, two tan). The grass reference is the bible's own panels (the farmhouse and the stump), which the style refs already carry. ROUND 2 (2026-10-20, owner's notes in art-pipeline-plan.md §7c): grass-2, dirt-2, slate, cobble-2, pavement, sand, grass-3. HARD BUDGET 10 images; the coloured guides guides/patch4-<type>.png carry today's tileColors.js colour so the model keeps it.

grass.prompt: SUBJECT: a GROUND TEXTURE panel, grass only. The LAST attached image is a layout guide, a 4 x 4 patch of sixteen pale tiles: fill ALL sixteen squares, edge to edge, with the same short meadow grass that surrounds the farmhouse and the stump in the approved panels (the same green, the same soft leafy fill, a few small darker tufts and a few lighter blades, drawn as crisp shapes). Draw the faint grid lines as thin tile edges exactly where the guide has them. No props, no objects, no flowers, no characters, no shadows, no path: ground only. Keep the fill even and REPEATABLE: the left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom with no visible seam, no vignette, no lighting gradient across the panel, no feature that only appears once. Do not leave any square pale.

edge-grass-dirt.prompt: SUBJECT: a GROUND TEXTURE panel showing where grass meets a dirt path. Fill the green columns, edge to edge, with the same short meadow grass that surrounds the farmhouse and the stump in the approved panels, and fill the tan columns with warm ochre packed earth with a few small clods and pebbles drawn as crisp shapes.
